description: Ministry of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government - The Compulsory retirement age for Medical officers, Dental Surgeon Officers, Nursing Officers of all grades in the Public Service will be extended to 63 years
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the compulsory retirement age for specific public service positions (Medical Officers, Dental Surgeon Officers, Nursing Officers) under the Minutes on Pensions. It deals specifically with public service conditions and retirement benefits, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government personnel changes (which would require naming specific individuals) or organizational changes.
